DECLARATION THIS DECLARATION is made by D & D Bowne Street Realty Corp., whose address is 435 Hunter Avenue,Bronx, NY 10464,hereinafter called the "Declarant." WITNESSETH WHEREAS the Declarant is the owner of certain real property located in Bronx County, City and State of New York, Bronx Tax Block 5634, Lot 33, which real property is described in the metes and bounds description attached hereto as "Attachment A" and which real property is hereinafter referred to as the"Subject Property"; and WHEREAS Declarant, desiring to develop the Subject Property, has submitted an application (No.2-6003-00148/00004) to the New York State Department ofEnvironmental Conservation("the Department" or "DEC") requesting a permit under Articles 15 and 25 of the Environmental Conservation Law (the Protection of Waters Act and the Tidal Wetlands Act,respectively);and a Water Quality Certification pursuant to section 401 of the Clean Water Act; and WHEREAS Declarant represents and warrants that no restriction of rccord on the use of the Subject Property, nor any present or presently existing future estate or interest in the Subject Property, nor any lien, obligation, covenant, limitation, or encumbrance of any kind precludes, presently or potentially, the imposition of the restrictions, covenants, obligations, easements and agreements of this Declaration or the development of the Subject Property in accordance therewith; and WHEREAS the DEC has issued permits 2-6003-00148/00004 through 2-6003-00148/00006 to develop the Subject Property in accordance with said permit application under Articles 15 and 25 of the Environmental Conservation Law and the CleanWater Act; NOW, THEREFORE, Declarant does hereby declare that the Property shall only be held, sold, conveyed and occupied subject to the following restrictions, covenants, obligations, and agreements which are for the purpose of maintaining and protecting the tidal wetland and area adjacent thereto for the benefit of the citizens of the State of NewYork generally and for the benefit specifically ofthe owners and/or occupants ofpropertyidentified asBronxTax Block5634,Lot 33, which maintenance and protection is in mitigation of the impacts to such regulated wetland and adjacent area resulting from the proposed site improvements as shown in Attachment B, and which restrictions, covenants, obligations, and agreements shall run with such real property, binding every party having any right, title, or interest in the Subject Property or any part thereof and binding all heirs, executors, administrators, successors, and assigns. 1

1. Declarant hereby covenants and agrees to mitigate impervious surface percent coverage exceedance and the presumptively incompatible use classification of this project pursuant to 6NYCRR Part 661 - Tidal Wetlands Land Use Regulations. This mitigation includes the installation of a green roof and solar panels, the installation of permeable pavers in the parking area, and the creation ofa planted buffer areawith a bio retentionbasin and overflow spillway between the wetland and the developed area, as shown in the following drawings prepared by Edward M. Weinstein, reduced size copies of which is appended hereto as Attachment B: Drawing Number Date Last Revised Sheet 3Aof 7 November 4,2014 Sheet3Bof 7 December 2, 2014 Sheet 3C of 7 November4,2014 Sheet 3D of 7 November4,2014 Sheet 3E of 7 November 24, 2014 2. Additionally, Declarant also covenants and agrees to develop and maintain in perpetuity the Subject Property in accordance with the terms and conditions of the permits issued to the Declarant under DEC Permit Nos. 2-6003-00148/00004 through 2-6003-00148/00006.A copy of the permits is enclosed hereto as Attachment C. 3. In addition, to overcome the presumption ofincoimpatible use and to protect and preserve the present and future natural resource benefits provided by the underwater portion of the Subject Property, Declarant specifically covenants and agrees to establish and maintain in perpetuity an "Area of No Disturbance," which encompasses the underwater portion of Block 5634, Lot 33 and is depicted and labeled “Area of No Disturbance” on Attachment E, appended hereto.A Metes and Bounds Description of the Area of No Disturbance is appended hereto as Attachment D. Within the Area of No Disturbance Declarant covenants and agrees to abstain from the installation and use of any fixed or floating structures and mooring facilities,to abstain from any disturbance of the land under water, and to actively prevent third parties from engaging in such installation, utilization, or disturbance. 4. Declarant, its successors and assigns and any future grantees of all or a portion of any interest in the Subject Property shall set forth these covenants, restrictions and declarations in any and all transfers or leases of the property and shall by the terims of such leases subject the transferee or lessee to the covenants and restrictions contained herein.The failure of the Declarant, its successors or assigns to so condition transfers or leases shall not invalidate the automatic subjugation of the transferees or lessees to these covenants,restrictions and declarations. 5.
